style.prompt:
Design a cheerful, beautifully typeset community picnic flyer, flat vector-like illustration, warm cream paper background, coral red headline, leafy green typography, butter-yellow and sky-blue accents. Small charming hand-drawn illustrated daisies and wildflowers arranged around the edges, a subtle gingham picnic blanket motif near bottom. Clean professional graphic design, strong readable typography, ample negative space. Centered composition suitable for subsequent portrait 4:5 layout. Render EXACTLY these four lines of text, clearly spelled, and absolutely no other text, letters, logos, labels, or watermark:
Community Picnic
12 June 2027
12:00–15:00
Maple Park, East Gate
Make Community Picnic the large prominent headline; the other three lines neatly stacked underneath. All text inside a generous safe central region. Cheerful welcoming sunny picnic atmosphere.
